h.hypothesis: Prioritizing inspection of open cooking surfaces (stoveburners) before closed storage units or general countertops yields faster acquisition for pans than semantic prioritization of cabinets or spatial listing order, as pans are functionally associated with stoves and often left on them.

probe_summary.evidence_goal: Step count to acquire the target object compared to baseline strategies (spatial order or cabinet-first).
probe_summary.local_function: Select and navigate to a specific receptacle type based on a search heuristic (semantic vs. spatial/open-surface).
probe_summary.realization_pattern: Stove-first traversal: prioritize inspecting stoveburners over other receptacle types.
stop_conditions: All stoveburners inspected without finding target (trigger fallback to general scan).

h.scope: ALFWorld kitchen tasks where the target object is a cooking utensil (e.g., pan, pot) and multiple receptacle types are visible at entry.

observed_search_acquisition_trajectory.endpoint_scope: target_acquisition_only; downstream task transformations/placement not asserted
